EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Re: National Funding Agreement #{!Opportunity.Merchant_Number__c}
Welcome to National Funding!
We are pleased that you have chosen us for your financial solution and feel certain you have made the right decision for your company.
Very shortly you will receive a copy of your contract for your files. Please do not hesitate to call with questions or issues, should they arise. You can reach our renewal team at (800) 382-2856. Our goal is to help you with the success of your business with this funding, and any future financing needs you may have.
Thank you for using National Funding. We look forward to working with you again in the future.
Sincerely,
National Funding
If you no longer wish to receive emails from National Funding, send an email to emailreply@nationalfunding.com with Unsubscribe in the subject line. You may also unsubscribe by sending written notice to: National Funding Unsubscribe, 9530 Towne Centre Dr., Suite 120, San Diego, CA 92121. Thank you.
National Funding respects your privacy. Our commitment to your privacy is described in our Privacy Policy which is available on our website for your reference. © 2018 National Funding. All Rights Reserved.
